title: RTL text pptx 001
notes: real RTL slide content in DrawingML: one right-aligned Arabic paragraph (the 28-letter alphabet string shared with docx rtl-text 001) with a:pPr algn="r" + rtl="1", three buChar-bulleted Hebrew paragraphs (strings shared with docx rtl-text 002, same rtl/algn flags), and a mixed-direction note paragraph whose embedded Latin run «stichos» is the only run marked a:rPr rtl="0" — the LTR island inside the RTL context. Hebrew runs carry a:cs typeface="Noto Sans Hebrew" (python-pptx has no bidi API; flags set on raw oxml attributes). reference_text is the exact inserted strings in logical order; bidi reordering is a render-time concern.
